"You need to build everything from scratch to get custom software."

It is one of the most common misconceptions in tech. When founders hear "custom," they picture years of development and endless code.

In reality, building custom software today rarely means writing a database or user authentication from zero. Reliable open-source frameworks, secure cloud infrastructure, and robust third-party APIs handle the foundation.

Your development partner should focus custom code strictly on your unique workflow and business logic. That is how you get a tailored solution without paying for reinvented wheels.
